api_key.description: API key for authentication. Can also be set using the `PORKBUN_API_KEY` environment variable.

ipv4_only.description: Use IPv4 only for API requests. Defaults to false.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for API requests. Defaults to 3.

secret_api_key.description: Secret API key for authentication. Can also be set using the `PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY` environment variable.

block.description: Provider for managing domains, DNS records, URL forwarding, and nameserver configurations for domains registered with Porkbun.

content.description: The answer content for the record. Please see the DNS management popup from the domain management console for proper formatting of each record type.

domain.description: The domain name for which to create the DNS record (e.g., example.com).

id.description: The ID of the DNS record. This is assigned by Porkbun and used for record management.

notes.description: Notes for the DNS record. This is read-only and can only be set from the Porkbun web interface.

prio.description: The priority of the record for those that support it.

subdomain.description: The subdomain for the record being created, not including the domain itself. Leave blank to create a record on the root domain. Use * to create a wildcard record.

ttl.description: The time to live in seconds for the record. The minimum and the default is 600 seconds.

type.description: The type of DNS record to create (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, ALIAS, SRV, TLSA, CAA, HTTPS, SVCB).

block.description: Manage DNS records for domains registered through Porkbun.

domain.description: Fully‑qualified domain name (FQDN) whose DNSSEC settings will be managed, for example `example.com`.

algorithm.description: DNSSEC algorithm identifier, as defined in RFC 8624.

digest.description: Digest (hash) of the DNSKEY record, encoded in hexadecimal. Length and contents depend on `digest_type`.

digest_type.description: Hash algorithm identifier used to create the DS digest.

key_tag.description: Key tag (key ID) calculated from the public key. Provided as a decimal string.

ds_data.description: Delegation‑Signer (DS) record parameters. Many registries require DS data to enable DNSSEC, while some ignore or reject it. If your registry returns an error, omit this block and provide `key_data` instead. **At least one of `ds_data` or `key_data` must be supplied.**

algorithm.description: DNSSEC algorithm identifier, as defined in RFC 8624.

flags.description: DNSKEY flags field (RFC 4034 §2.1). Common values are `256` (ZSK) and `257` (KSK).

public_key.description: Base64‑encoded public key material of the DNSKEY record.

key_data.description: DNSKEY record data. Some registries accept `key_data` instead of, or in addition to, `ds_data`. If DS records are rejected, try creating DNSSEC with `key_data` only. **At least one of `ds_data` or `key_data` must be supplied.**

max_sig_life.description: Maximum lifetime of a DNSSEC signature (RRSIG), in seconds. **Note:** The Porkbun API does not return this value, so it cannot be read back and drift detection for this argument is disabled.

block.description: Manages DNSSEC settings (DS/DNSKEY) for a domain registered with Porkbun.

domain.description: The domain name to manage nameservers for. Must be a domain registered with Porkbun.

nameservers.description: A list of name server host names.

block.description: Manage custom nameservers for domains registered through Porkbun.

domain.description: The domain name for which to configure URL forwarding (e.g., example.com).

id.description: The ID of the URL forward. Automatically generated by Porkbun.

include_path.description: Whether or not to include the URI path in the redirection.

location.description: Where you'd like to forward the domain to.

subdomain.description: A subdomain that you would like to add URL forwarding for. Leave this blank to forward the root domain.

wildcard.description: Also forward all subdomains of the domain.

block.description: Manage URL forwarding rules for domains registered through Porkbun.

auto_renew.description: Indicates whether automatic renewal is enabled for the domain. When enabled, the domain will be automatically renewed before expiration.

domain.description: The domain name to retrieve information for. Must be a domain registered with or managed through Porkbun.

labels.description: A list of labels associated with the domain. Labels are used to categorize and organize domains within your Porkbun account.

not_local.description: Indicates if the domain is registered elsewhere but using Porkbun's DNS (true) or if it's registered with Porkbun (false).

security_lock.description: Indicates whether the domain transfer lock is enabled, which prevents unauthorized domain transfers to other registrars.

status.description: The current status of the domain (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', etc.).

tld.description: The top-level domain (TLD) of the domain (e.g., 'com', 'org', 'net').

whois_privacy.description: Indicates whether WHOIS privacy protection is enabled for the domain, which hides personal contact information in public WHOIS records.

block.description: Retrieve information about a specific domain.

domains.description: A list of domains registered with Porkbun.

include_labels.description: Whether to include labels in the response. Defaults to false.

block.description: Retrieves information about all domains registered with Porkbun.

domain.description: The domain name to retrieve nameserver information for. Must be a domain registered with or managed through Porkbun.

nameservers.description: A list of name server host names.

block.description: Retrieve the current nameservers for a domain registered with Porkbun.

domain.description: The domain name for which to retrieve SSL certificate information.

block.description: Retrieve SSL certificate information for domains using Porkbun's free SSL certificates.
